def factor_range_exhaustion_ema_smooth(df):
    """Range expansion exhaustion with EMA smoothing: large daily range, negative 3-day return, and elevated volume signal a mean-reverting bounce. Smoothed with EMA (span=5) for timelier signals."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    range_z = (range_ - range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()) / range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1).replace(0, np.nan)
    ret3 = df_copy["close"].pct_change(3)
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20, high_threshold=1.5, low_threshold=0.6)
    vol_weight = vol_ratio.clip(0, 2) / 2.0
    raw = -ret3 * range_z * vol_weight
    df_copy["factor_range_exhaustion_ema_smooth"] = raw.ewm(span=5, min_periods=5).mean()
    return df_copy["factor_range_exhaustion_ema_smooth"]
